format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this feel, like "land-dust". It matches the file name.

on.description: The event that sets it off, like "hero.landed".

dust.description: A burst of dust. Left out means none.

color.description: The colour of the dust, as # and six digits, like #e8dcc0.

speed.description: How fast the specks fly out, in tiles a second.

life.description: How long a speck lasts, in ticks. 60 ticks is one second.

shake.description: The picture shakes. Left out means no shake.

strength.description: How far the picture shakes, in tiles. At most 1.

ticks.description: How long it shakes, in ticks. 60 ticks is one second.

freeze.description: The game holds still for a moment. Left out means no freeze.

ticks.description: How long the game holds still, in ticks. 60 ticks is one second.
